functional_requirements.text: Detect eligible securities transaction execution events in EquatePlus.
Map executed transaction data to SEC Form 4 fields.
Generate a pre-filled SEC Form 4 within 5 minutes of transaction execution.
Validate all form fields against regulatory standards before submission; block submission on validation failure.
Securely stream transaction and form data to designated legal/compliance users in real time.
Send a notification to executive and legal team when a regulatory form is generated.
Send a notification to executive and legal team when a form is successfully submitted.

Send a deadline-risk warning notification when a filing is unsubmitted and less than 12 hours remain, computed against the EDGAR 5:30pm ET same-day cutoff (see vision.md Regulatory Posture #2, not the raw calendar deadline).
Allow a Legal & Compliance user to review a pre-filled form.
Allow a Legal & Compliance user to edit a pre-filled form's fields, with changes re-validated.
Allow a Legal & Compliance user to approve a validated form for submission.
Log every form generation, edit, approval, and submission action with timestamp and user ID for audit purposes.
Provide access to historical filings and their statuses for authorized users.
Support bulk processing of multiple trades executed within a short timeframe, generating a separate form per trade with none omitted.
Provide a dashboard for legal/compliance users to monitor filing status, deadlines, and error alerts in real time.
Allow export of filing data in CSV or PDF format for internal audits.
Detect transaction data sync failures and notify legal/compliance users immediately.
functional_requirements.source_fr: epics-from-prd.md US5 / E3.F1 (not a numbered PRD §5 FR — sourced from the user-story and epic breakdown instead)

functional_requirements.text: Support integration with third-party compliance analytics tools via secure export/API.
Support generation and validation of additional regulatory forms beyond SEC Form 4 (e.g. Form 5, Form 144) via a modular form-template mechanism.

Submit an approved form to SEC EDGAR (Regulation S-T electronic filing), OR hand off the completed form package to an existing manual/agent-assisted EDGAR filing process — mechanism to be confirmed with Legal & Compliance before Design.
functional_requirements.source_fr: New — surfaced by vision.md Regulatory Posture #1, not present verbatim in PRD

compound_splits.note: Split into detect (FR-001), map (FR-002), generate-within-5min (FR-003) — original bundled detection, mapping, and generation into one requirement.
Split into three distinct notification triggers (FR-006 generated, FR-007 submitted, FR-008 deadline-risk) — each has different timing/recipients/urgency and should be independently testable.
Split into review (FR-009), edit (FR-010), approve (FR-011) — distinct user actions with separate audit events per FR-012.

Split into log-actions (FR-012, direct text match) and historical-filing-access (FR-013, derived from AC5 rather than FR5's literal text since FR5 doesn't explicitly mention a browsing/access UI) — disclosed here per quality-gate finding; originally omitted from this list.
